entries.source: Fine boots that increase your Physical Save by 10.
entries.target: 可以提高你10点物理豁免的好靴。

entries.source: A beautiful amulet that increases your Mindpower by 3.
entries.target: 一条精美的项链，可以提高你3点精神强度。

entries.source: A finely-wrought helmet that increases your Accuracy by 6.
entries.target: 一只可以提高你6点命中的精工头盔。
一只镶有红宝石的戒指。

entries.source: Basic tactic: Do not get surrounded

entries.target: 冒险者启蒙地下城已完成

entries.source: The rift leads to another part of the morass.
entries.target: 裂隙通往混沌之沼的另一个区域。

entries.source:
The rift has brought you back to Point Zero, and the source of the disturbances.
A temporal defiler is attacking the town, all the Keepers in range are attacking it!
entries.target:
这个裂隙将你带回到了零点圣域，你看到了这些混乱的源头。
一只时空污秽魔正在攻击圣域，附近所有的守卫都在攻击它！
一只近乎半透明的蜘蛛幼体。

entries.source: A large brownish arachnid, its fangs drip with a strange fluid.
entries.target: 一只巨大的褐色蜘蛛，它的尖牙不断滴落着奇怪的液体。

entries.source: A large brownish arachnid spinning its web.  It doesn't look pleased that you've disturbed its work.
entries.target: 一只正在结网的巨大褐色蜘蛛，你的打扰使它很不高兴。

entries.source: Easily as big as a horse, this giant spider menaces at you with claws and fangs.
entries.target: 这只巨型蜘蛛足有一匹马那么大，用利爪和獠牙威胁着你。

entries.source: As you vanquish the queen you notice a temporal thread that seems to have been controlling her. It seems to go through a rift.
entries.target: 当你杀死织网蛛后时，你注意到某根时间线曾控制着她。这根线似乎来自某个裂隙。

entries.source: It looks like a very tiny star -- deep black -- and yet it somehow shines.
entries.target: 它看起来像是一颗非常小巧的星星——深邃而黑暗——却不知为何闪着光芒。
